description: This file contains implementation of several Orleans grain classes for internal testing, including test grains and observer grains, with methods for activation, deactivation, message handling, and interaction with Orleans runtime features.

classes.name: TestGrain
classes.description: A test implementation of an Orleans grain with key management, labels, timers, and request context handling, used for internal testing scenarios.

classes.name: TestGrainLongActivateAsync
classes.description: A grain class with a delayed activation for testing activation scenarios.

classes.name: GuidTestGrain
classes.description: A grain with GUID primary key, providing methods for identity retrieval and runtime info.

classes.name: OneWayGrain
classes.description: A grain implementing one-way messaging, observer pattern, and dynamic silo interactions for testing.

classes.name: CanBeOneWayGrain
classes.description: A simple grain supporting observer notifications and exception throwing, for testing purposes.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation logic, including validation and initialization.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation logging.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the primary key as a long.

methods.name: GetLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the grain instance.

methods.name: SetLabel
methods.description: Sets the label for the grain instance.

methods.name: DoLongAction
methods.description: Performs a long-running task with a delay specified by timespan.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a periodic timer that triggers TimerTick.

methods.name: TimerTick
methods.description: Method invoked periodically by timer; logs a message.

methods.name: TestRequestContext
methods.description: Sets and retrieves data within RequestContext to test propagation.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime instance ID.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the activation ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetGrainReference
methods.description: Gets a reference to this grain as the interface ITestGrain.

methods.name: GetMultipleGrainInterfaces_Array
methods.description: Creates multiple grain references and returns them as an array.

methods.name: GetMultipleGrainInterfaces_List
methods.description: Creates multiple grain references and returns them as a list.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync (GuidTestGrain)
methods.description: Activation logic specific to GUID-based grain.

methods.name: GetKey (GuidTestGrain)
methods.description: Returns the grain's GUID primary key.

methods.name: GetSiloAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the silo address where the grain resides.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Increments count, optionally notifies observer.

methods.name: NotifyValueTask
methods.description: Increments count, returns ValueTask, optionally notifies observer.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrain
methods.description: Notifies another grain and checks if completed synchronously.

methods.name: NotifyOtherGrainValueTask
methods.description: Notifies another grain using ValueTask and checks completion status.

methods.name: GetActivationId (GuidTestGrain)
methods.description: Returns the GUID activation ID.

methods.name: GetActivationAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the activation address for a given grain.

methods.name: StateChanged
methods.description: Method to signal state change, invoked by observer.

methods.name: SendSignalTo
methods.description: Sends a signal to another grain.

methods.name: SignalSelfViaOther
methods.description: Signals itself via another grain.

methods.name: WaitForSignal
methods.description: Await for a signal, returning count and ID.

methods.name: Signal
methods.description: Receives a signal, sets result in TaskCompletionSource.
